description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Loan Interest Recalculation feature in the Apache Fineract platform, focusing on Case of Business on Closure of Business (COB) for loans, with various scenarios including interest recalculations, charge additions post-maturity, early and late repayments, and different recalculation strategies. It utilizes REST API interactions, loan application workflows, and validation methods to ensure correct behavior of loans under different interest recalculation conditions.

classes.name: LoanInterestRecalculationCOBTest
classes.description: Integration tests for loan interest recalculation scenarios involving COB in the Fineract platform, extending the BaseLoanIntegrationTest to utilize common setup, helpers, and validation methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the test class, including REST API initialization, request and response specification configuration, client creation, and COB business steps configuration.

methods.name: logLoanDetails
methods.description: Logs detailed information of the loan's repayment schedule, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, and due dates for each period.

methods.name: testInterestRecalculationInCaseOfTinyAmountOfRepaymentsEveryRepaymentPeriodForProgressiveLoanSameAsRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Tests interest recalculation logic when tiny repayments are made every period for a progressive loan with same as repayment period recalculation frequency.

methods.name: verifyLoanInstallmentRecalculatedIfThereIsOverdueInstallmentOn4IProgressiveLoanCOBStepDaily
methods.description: Verifies loan installment recalculation when an overdue installment exists, with the recalculation frequency set to daily, during COB step.

methods.name: verifyLoanInstallmentRecalculatedIfThereIsOverdueInstallmentOn4IProgressiveLoanCOBStep
methods.description: Verifies recalculation with overdue installment during COB step for a loan with default recalculation frequency.

methods.name: verifyLoanInstallmentRecalculatedIfThereIsOverdueInstallmentOn4IProgressiveLoanCOBStepLatePayPayOnDuePayLatePayOnDateDaily
methods.description: Verifies recalculation behavior when overdue payments happen on specific dates, for daily recalculation frequency during COB step.

methods.name: verifyLoanInstallmentRecalculatedIfThereIsOverdueInstallmentOn4IProgressiveLoanCOBStepLatePartialRepaymentDailyInterestCalculation
methods.description: Tests recalculation with overdue partial payments and interest calculation specifics during COB step.

methods.name: verifyChargeCreationAfterMaturityDateOnInterestBearingProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Tests creating and adding charges after a loan's maturity date for interest-bearing progressive loans, verifying schedule adjustments.

methods.name: verifyEarlyLateRepaymentOnProgressiveLoanNextInstallmentAllocationRepayLessThenEmi
methods.description: Validates handling of early or late repayments that are less than EMI, during progressive loan COB processing.

methods.name: verifyLoanInstallmentRecalculatedIfThereIsOverdueInstallmentOnCumulativeLoanCOBStep
methods.description: Checks recalculation logic for cumulative loans with overdue installments, during COB step.

methods.name: verifyLoanInstallmentRecalculatedIfThereIsOverdueInstallmentOnProgressiveLoanJob
methods.description: Verifies recalculation triggered by scheduled jobs for progressive loans with overdue installments.

methods.name: verifyLoanInstallmentRecalculatedIfThereIsOverdueInstallmentOnProgressiveLoanMultiOverdueSingleRepayment
methods.description: Tests recalculation with multiple overdue single-repayment installments, during COB processing.
